candidates.tagline: McLaren rebranded. Their new logo looks like a Parisian fashion house. It was inspired by a gas station.
candidates.story: On September 22, 2026, McLaren unveiled a unified brand identity for Racing and Automotive built around a new wordmark inspired by 1920s lettering above the McLaren family service station in Auckland — which critics immediately noted looks more like Chanel or Louis Vuitton than a supercar brand.
candidates.why_funny: A Formula 1 team and supercar company looked deep into their heritage and emerged with: gas station chic.
candidates.alt: A gleaming teal-blue McLaren 720S Spider supercar with its distinctive dihedral scissor door fully raised, on display at a Sotheby's auction preview in Hong Kong

candidates.tagline: Trump told the UN that AI is now called 'super intelligence' — that wasn't one of the options in his own poll
candidates.story: At the UN General Assembly on September 22, 2026, President Trump announced the US would rename 'artificial intelligence' to 'super intelligence' in all government documents — ignoring the three renaming choices (Superior, Extreme, or Supreme Intelligence) he had asked his Truth Social followers to vote on just days earlier.
candidates.why_funny: He crowdsourced three name options, picked none of them, and announced the fourth to the entire world at the UN.
candidates.alt: Wide shot of the United Nations General Assembly hall in New York packed with world leaders and delegates, with Trump visible at the podium and on the large video screens above
